validity.researcher_notes: This row carries no length_ratio flag in the brief, and while researching the sibling segments' units problem I confirmed why: OPEC ASB2012's raw Table 4.10 entry for 'Brega/Khoms' is 645 (nominally tabulated under a 'Length (miles)' header, but for the Libya block these raw numbers are actually already km -- see the P1862 shard's researcher_notes for the full miles-vs-km deduction, corroborated by an independent World Bank/Tractebel report which states the western coastal section spans 645 km from Brega to Khoms with ~370 mmscf/d capacity). GEM's sheet already carries 645 km for this segment unconverted, i.e. correct, whereas the other three segments' sheet values (396, 201, 158) appear to have been produced by erroneously applying a miles->km conversion factor to OPEC's already-km raw numbers. This is a useful corroborating data point for the pattern documented on P1862/P1864/P1865, not an action item for this row.
